en.html:
Kuniuji"...D-Doushin! DOUSHIN!!"
Kuniuji"S-stop! This—this cruelty!"
Doushin"Well now..."
Kuniuji"..."
Doushin"Something you were saying, Your Highness?"
Kuniuji"W-what?"
Doushin"Unfortunately the dance is in progress. An artist's rule, Highness. Even if his parent is dying, he cannot leave the stage."
Doushin"After this finishes, your matter I will attend to. For now, kindly excuse."
Kuniuji"You bloody fool! THIS is what I am ordering you to stop!!"
Doushin"Arre re. Such a difficult young lord. No understanding of refinement..."
Doushin"If you insist, why not give somebody an order?"
Kuniuji"What...?"
Doushin"This Lord of Koga. Doushin Yusa, the monk."
Doushin"Drag him off that stage. Tell your retainers, na."
Kuniuji"............"
Kuniuji"G—GO!!"

Kuniuji"...Why is nobody answering? Somebody! Anybody—"
Doushin"Enough of this disgraceful noise, you little brat!"
Kuniuji"!?"
Doushin"Why does nobody obey you? Everybody knows why. Only the one issuing orders has not worked it out!"
Doushin"An ornamental palanquin suddenly starts speaking. Now the thing we carry wishes to give directions! Who will obey? They will only wish the bloody palanquin would shut up!"
Doushin"So sit quietly, like the ornament you are! We are carrying you. Kindly do not obstruct the carrying!"
Doushin"Give your grand orders when you can seize Doushin yourself! With your own hands, and nobody else's strength to depend on!"
Kuniuji"...Ah... ...Auh............"

Clenched it. Crushed it.

Perhaps reason had already left her. The juice dripped from her fist, and still she kept crushing.

en.html:
Doushin"Arre, what has the flower done to you? Such cruelty to an innocent thing!"
Doushin"And now you would silence me before I have finished my criticism!"
Sakurako"Stop this! You monster!"
Doushin"You crush the flower; I am the monster. Very convenient, this division of responsibility."
Doushin"First the flower, now my character. All that fine breeding—and such manners!"
Sakurako"............"
Doushin"Even the silence is disapproving. A princess wastes nothing."
Doushin"Such distinction! A whole audience, and still you think only of how you are being treated."
Sakurako"...Ah..."
Doushin"No, the answer is not satisfactory. Apparently I have not made myself unpleasant enough."
Doushin"I have considerably worse to say. We are nowhere near the end."
Sakurako"!"
Sakurako"Please... stop..."
Doushin"Please? Ab aayi na baat. Now we remember our manners."

Earlier you permitted Rokuhara to speak of Okabe, remember?"Sakurako"............"Doushin"You cannot speak of Okabe yourself. So speak of us. Tell the world about Rokuhara."Doushin"Come, come. I am waiting for the answer."Sakurako"...Ah..."Doushin"Princess of Okabe! Tell us what Rokuhara is!"Sakurako"YOU VILE BASTARDS!"Doushin"Exactly!"Sakurako"NOT EVEN HUMAN!"Doushin"Exactly!"Sakurako"Monsters! Devils! You rabble from the bottom of hell!"Doushin"EXACTLY!"

ja.html:
桜子「っ……」
桜子「く……ぅッ……!!」
童心「ようし、咲いた！ 　見事に咲いたわ！」
童心「鮮やかな赤が白地に映える…… 　雅な花にてござ候!!」
桜子「……古河……公方……！」
桜子「遊佐、童心……!!」
童心「ほう？　ほゥ。 　何やら音色が変わってきたの」
童心「ならばこちらも合わせようか。 　……のう、桜子どの。先程、六波羅の口を もって岡部を語る許しを頂いたな？」
桜子「…………」
童心「姫の口から岡部は語られぬ。 　然らば姫は、我ら六波羅を語られませい」
童心「さぁさ。 　言葉が喉に支えるとあらば、一押しくれて 差し上げるほどに……！」
桜子「うぐっ……！」
童心「岡部の姫よ！ 　六波羅を語れい！」
桜子「――外道ッッ!!」
童心「いかにも！」
桜子「人非人ッッ!!」
童心「いかにも！」
桜子「鬼畜！　悪魔！ 　地獄の底から来た奴輩やつばら!!」
童心「いかにもッッ!!」

Every word she gave him was condemnation.

Every word he received was praise.

How horribly the two fitted together.

en.html:
Doushin"At last! An assessment worthy of us!"
Doushin"Renounce your importance, they tell an old monk. Achha, and after that who will manage everything?"
Doushin"Let paradise wait. This world clearly cannot function without me."
Doushin"And my remarks to you are not finished yet."
Sakurako"...!"
Doushin"Your father, what would he say on hearing you now? Your brother also?"
Sakurako"...What...?"
Doushin"More protests? Encouragement I shall call them."
Doushin"The criticisms are not exhausted. Arre, we have hardly started."
Doushin"Huh-huu! An old man's habits, so easily they do not change."
Sakurako"NO...! STOP...!"

ja.html:
童心「たまらぬ！　たまらぬわえ！ 　何と官能的な調べであろう！」
童心「うっかり成仏してしまいそうじゃわ！ 　姫よ、わしが往生してしまわぬよう、しっ かり締めて捕まえておいてくれい！」
童心「この喜悦は現世限りのもの。 　これあると知れば、わしはたとえ極楽から でも戻って来られるからのぅ！」
童心「それ、参るぞ！」
桜子「く……あぁぁ!!」
童心「父と兄に良く見てもらえぃ！ 　仇に子種を注がれる姿……とくとのう！」
桜子「!? 　なっ――そんな」
童心「おう、暴れるでない。 　そう喜ぶでない」
童心「焦らずとも、きちんと孕ませてやるからの。 　その後は……菊の花・・・じゃ」
童心「そちらもなかなか乙なものぞ？ 　ふわっはっはっはっはっはっはっはっは!!」
桜子「いやぁぁぁーーーーーーーーーーーーっ!!」
